items.title: Netflix Reworks Conductor for 420 Million Monthly Workflow Executions and 10X Larger Workflows
items.blurb: Netflix has reworked its Conductor workflow orchestration engine to handle larger workloads, increasing supported workflow size from about 2,500 to 30,000 tasks and reducing p99 workflow evaluation latency by about 40%.

items.title: One Decade of Rustls: Evolution, Benchmarks, and Future Roadmap
items.blurb: Rustls, a Rust TLS library, marks its decade-long progression from a grassroots project to a funded open-source initiative.
